demonstrates: Ordinary tasks, in ADDING order, each with the done mark it ends with. The reader adds all of them in file order and only then marks the done ones, because a new task is never born done (BR-08), and expects the reversal of this file with these marks (BR-11). A repeated text is two tasks (BR-12), characters outside ASCII survive the whole stack, a one-character task is the minimum as an ordinary value, and no text holds a line break (BR-07).
